definition.def: A sequence of events or things is a number of events or things that come one after another in a particular order.
examples: ...the sequence of events which led to the murder. [+ of]
...a dazzling sequence of novels by John Updike. [+ of]

definition.def: A particular sequence is a particular order in which things happen or are arranged.
examples: ...the colour sequence yellow, orange, purple, blue, green and white.
The chronological sequence gives the book an element of structure.

definition.def: A film sequence is a part of a film that shows a single set of actions.
examples: The best sequence in the film occurs when Roth stops at a house he used to live in.

definition.def: A gene sequence or a DNA sequence is the order in which the elements making up a particular gene are combined.
examples: The project is nothing less than mapping every gene sequence in the human body.
...the complete DNA sequence of the human genome. [+ of]

definition.def: To sequence genes is to determine the order in which the elements that make them up are combined.
examples: The technique offers a means of sequencing the human genome much more quickly. [VERB noun]
